sanskrit: puruṣaṃ nīlameghābhaṃ puḍarīkanibhe kṣaṇam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayabhītastu vepamānaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ | abravīnna mayā jñātastvaṃ vibho divyarūpadhṛk || 18 || ajñānāttvaṃ mayā viddhastvatpadāgre surottama | kṣantumarhasi me nātha na tvaṃ kroddhumihārhasi || 19 ||
english: Seeing him, he got terrified. Trembling (with fear) and with folded hands, he spoke: “I did not know, O Lord, that it was you, the divine-bodied one. O excellent Sura, (it was) out of ignorance that you were hit in the sole of your foot. It behoves you, O Lord, to pardon me and not to be angry with me.”

english: Therefore, after completing supreme punyas and jñana accumulations and attaining the sarvajñatā state, I shall educate those people about the truth of the things dharmata. After this, the yogi should slowly undo his lotus posture and make obeisance to all the Buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions and, after worshipping and eulogising them, he should undertake the great vow ‘mahāpraṇidhāna of ‘āryabhadracharya. After that an effort should be made to accumulate all endless punyas and jñāna collection replete with emptiness śunyata and supreme compassion mahākaruṇā.apmāc Such dhyana is free from all kinds of superimpositions.
